rows: task, phase, arm, step, opaque case alias, status, metrics; no original-ID mapping exported
planned_matrix: 30 dev rows: 2 learners x 3 checkpoints x 5 reused cases; 140 final rows: 7 arms x 20 cases

metrics.harness_final_EM: Last selected native guess exact match
metrics.actor_final_EM: Identifiable final model answer; random fallback and early ToT selected candidate are not assigned actor correctness
metrics.hit_at_any: At least one selected/logged guess correct, including final guess where present

null_semantics: Unavailable or undefined; never zero. Failed-episode metrics remain null.

bootstrap.interpretation: Posthoc descriptive complete-pair intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted success test

verification_limit: Public verifier checks arithmetic and file hashes, not private scoring, raw accounting or actual model execution
